title: OTT Releases This Weekend: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram, Raktanchal Season 3, and More

body:
This weekend's OTT lineup brings a packed slate of Indian and international content across major streaming platforms. From Samantha Ruth Prabhu's record-breaking Telugu blockbuster to the return of a gritty Uttar Pradesh crime saga, here's what's dropping on your screens.

Maa Inti Bangaaram — JioHotstar (July 17)

The headliner this week is undoubtedly Maa Inti Bangaaram, starring Samantha Ruth Prabhu as a former assassin who marries into a conservative family and must protect them from her violent past. The film has already made history as the highest-grossing solo female-led Telugu movie of all time, crossing the ₹100-crore mark during its theatrical run. Directed by B.V. Nandini Reddy, the film co-stars Gulshan Devaiah and Diganth Manchale.

Raktanchal Season 3 — Prime Video and MX Player (July 16)

The raw, unflinching crime drama Raktanchal returns for its third season, shifting the gang warfare from Purvanchal to the political corridors of Lucknow in the early 2000s. Kranti Prakash Jha reprises his role as Vijay Singh, now attempting to enter politics and dismantle the mafia from within, while Nikitin Dheer's Waseem Khan forms dangerous new alliances.

Heartstopper Forever — Netflix (July 17)

Netflix's beloved YA series Heartstopper returns for its final chapter. Kit Connor and Joe Locke lead the cast as Nick and Charlie navigate the challenge of a potential long-distance relationship as university looms.

The Hawk — Netflix (July 16)

Will Ferrell stars as a washed-up golf prodigy attempting a chaotic professional comeback in The Hawk. Directed by Jake Szymanski (Jury Duty), the sports comedy co-stars Willem Dafoe and Jane Lynch.

More Notable Releases

Ready or Not 2: Here I Come arrives on JioHotstar (July 16), bringing more high-stakes horror-comedy with Samara Weaving and Sarah Michelle Gellar. Wuthering Heights, starring Margot Robbie and Jacob Elordi and directed by Emerald Fennell, also premiered on JioHotstar. Netflix rounds out the weekend with Korean series Spooky in Love (July 18) and the dark fantasy drama The East Palace.

For diaspora audiences, Maa Inti Bangaaram and Raktanchal Season 3 are the clear must-watches — both showcase the evolving diversity and ambition of Indian streaming content now available globally.
